# HireGuard AI

HireGuard AI is a web security application for investigating public job postings and identifying suspicious redirects, unsafe URLs, credential collection flows, payment-related signals, and other job-scam indicators.

## Public pages
- https://job-guardai-musa.vercel.app/ — product overview and primary call to action.
- https://job-guardai-musa.vercel.app/privacy — privacy policy.
- https://job-guardai-musa.vercel.app/terms — terms and conditions.

## Capabilities
- Automated public job URL investigations.
- Browser-based evidence collection.
- Redirect and domain observation.
- Rule-based security findings.
- Risk scoring and severity classification.
- AI-assisted report summaries.
- Authenticated investigation history and reports.

## Important limitation
Automated findings are informational and can contain false positives or false negatives. Users should independently verify important decisions.
